verses.text: Then the whole body of them got up and brought Him before Pilate.
verses.textZh: 眾人都起來，把耶穌解到彼拉多面前，

verses.text: And they began to accuse Him, saying, 'We found this man misleading our nation and forbidding to pay taxes to Caesar, and saying that He Himself is Christ, a King.'
verses.textZh: 就告他說：我們見這人誘惑國民，禁止納稅給該撒，並說自己是基督，是王。

verses.text: So Pilate asked Him, saying, 'Are You the King of the Jews?' And He answered him and said, '[It is as] you say.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多問耶穌說：你是猶太人的王麼？耶穌回答說：你說的是。

verses.text: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, 'I find no guilt in this man.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多對祭司長和眾人說：我查不出這人有甚麼罪來。

verses.text: But they kept on insisting, saying, 'He stirs up the people, teaching all over Judea, starting from Galilee even as far as this place.'
verses.textZh: 但他們越發極力的說：他煽惑百姓，在猶太遍地傳道，從加利利起，直到這裡了。

verses.text: When Pilate heard it, he asked whether the man was a Galilean.
verses.textZh: 彼拉多一聽見，就問：這人是加利利人麼？

verses.text: And when he learned that He belonged to Herod's jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself also was in Jerusalem at that time.
verses.textZh: 既曉得耶穌屬希律所管，就把他送到希律那裡去。那時希律正在耶路撒冷。

verses.text: Now Herod was very glad when he saw Jesus; for he had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had been hearing about Him and was hoping to see some sign performed by Him.
verses.textZh: 希律看見耶穌，就很歡喜；因為聽見過他的事，久已想要見他，並且指望看他行一件神蹟。

verses.text: And he questioned Him at some length; but He answered him nothing.
verses.textZh: 於是問他許多的話；耶穌卻一言不答。

verses.text: And the chief priests and the scribes were standing there, accusing Him vehemently.
verses.textZh: 祭司長和文士都站著，極力的告他。

verses.text: And Herod with his soldiers, after treating Him with contempt and mocking Him, dressed Him in a gorgeous robe and sent Him back to Pilate.
verses.textZh: 希律和他的兵丁就藐視耶穌，戲弄他，給他穿上華麗衣服，把他送回彼拉多那裡去。

verses.text: Now Herod and Pilate became friends with one another that very day; for before they had been enemies with each other.
verses.textZh: 從前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。

verses.text: Pilate summoned the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
verses.textZh: 彼拉多傳齊了祭司長和官府並百姓，

verses.text: and said to them, 'You brought this man to me as one who incites the people to rebellion, and behold, having examined Him before you, I have found no guilt in this man regarding the charges which you make against Him.
verses.textZh: 就對他們說：你們解這人到我這裡，說他是誘惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾將你們告他的事，在你們面前審問他，並沒有查出他甚麼罪來；

verses.text: 'No, nor has Herod, for he sent Him back to us; and behold, nothing deserving death has been done by Him.
verses.textZh: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回來。可見他沒有做甚麼該死的事。

verses.text: 'Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.'
verses.textZh: 故此，我要責打他，把他釋放了。（有古卷在此有：

verses.text: [Now he was obliged to release to them at the feast one prisoner].
verses.textZh: 每逢這節期，巡撫必須釋放一個囚犯給他們。）

verses.text: But they cried out all together, saying, 'Away with this man, and release for us Barabbas!'
verses.textZh: 眾人卻一齊喊著說：除掉這個人！釋放巴拉巴給我們！

verses.text: (He was one who had been thrown into prison for an insurrection made in the city, and for murder.)
verses.textZh: 這巴拉巴是因在城裡作亂殺人，下在監裡的。

verses.text: Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, addressed them again,
verses.textZh: 彼拉多願意釋放耶穌，就又勸解他們。

verses.text: but they kept on calling out, saying, 'Crucify, crucify Him!'
verses.textZh: 無奈他們喊著說：釘他十字架！釘他十字架！

verses.text: And he said to them the third time, 'Why, what evil has this man done? I have found in Him no guilt [demanding] death; therefore I will punish Him and release Him.'
verses.textZh: 彼拉多第三次對他們說：為甚麼呢？這人作了甚麼惡事呢？我並沒有查出他甚麼該死的罪來。所以，我要責打他，把他釋放了。

verses.text: But they were insistent, with loud voices asking that He be crucified. And their voices [began] to prevail.
verses.textZh: 他們大聲催逼彼拉多，求他把耶穌釘在十字架上。他們的聲音就得了勝。

verses.text: And Pilate pronounced sentence that their demand be granted.
verses.textZh: 彼拉多這才照他們所求的定案，

verses.text: And he released the man they were asking for who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, but he delivered Jesus to their will.
verses.textZh: 把他們所求的那作亂殺人、下在監裡的釋放了，把耶穌交給他們，任憑他們的意思行。

verses.text: When they led Him away, they seized a man, Simon of Cyrene, coming in from the country, and placed on him the cross to carry behind Jesus.
verses.textZh: 帶耶穌去的時候，有一個古利奈人西門，從鄉下來；他們就抓住他，把十字架擱在他身上，叫他背著跟隨耶穌。

verses.text: And following Him was a large crowd of the people, and of women who were mourning and lamenting Him.
verses.textZh: 有許多百姓跟隨耶穌，內中有好些婦女；婦女們為他號咷痛哭。

verses.text: But Jesus turning to them said, 'Daughters of Jerusalem, stop weeping for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
verses.textZh: 耶穌轉身對他們說：耶路撒冷的女子，不要為我哭，當為自己和自己的兒女哭。

verses.text: 'For behold, the days are coming when they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'
verses.textZh: 因為日子要到，人必說：不生育的，和未曾懷胎的，未曾乳養嬰孩的，有福了！

verses.text: 'Then they will begin TO SAY TO THE MOUNTAINS, 'FALL ON US,' AND TO THE HILLS, 'COVER US.'
verses.textZh: 那時，人要向大山說：倒在我們身上！向小山說：遮蓋我們！

verses.text: 'For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?'
verses.textZh: 這些事既行在有汁水的樹上，那枯乾的樹將來怎麼樣呢？

verses.text: Two others also, who were criminals, were being led away to be put to death with Him.
verses.textZh: 又有兩個犯人，和耶穌一同帶來處死。

verses.text: When they came to the place called The Skull, there they crucified Him and the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.
verses.textZh: 到了一個地方，名叫髑髏地，就在那裡把耶穌釘在十字架上，又釘了兩個犯人：一個在左邊，一個在右邊。

verses.text: But Jesus was saying, 'Father, forgive them; for they do not know what they are doing.' And they cast lots, dividing up His garments among themselves.
verses.textZh: 當下耶穌說：父阿！赦免他們；因為他們所做的，他們不曉得。兵丁就拈鬮分他的衣服。

verses.text: And the people stood by, looking on. And even the rulers were sneering at Him, saying, 'He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is the Christ of God, His Chosen One.'
verses.textZh: 百姓站在那裡觀看。官府也嗤笑他，說：他救了別人；他若是基督，神所揀選的，可以救自己罷！

verses.text: The soldiers also mocked Him, coming up to Him, offering Him sour wine,
verses.textZh: 兵丁也戲弄他，上前拿醋送給他喝，

verses.text: and saying, 'If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!'
verses.textZh: 說：你若是猶太人的王，可以救自己罷！

verses.text: Now there was also an inscription above Him, 'THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.'
verses.textZh: 在耶穌以上有一個牌子（有古卷在此有：用希利尼、羅馬、希伯來的文字）寫著：這是猶太人的王。

verses.text: One of the criminals who were hanged [there] was hurling abuse at Him, saying, 'Are You not the Christ? Save Yourself and us!'
verses.textZh: 那同釘的兩個犯人有一個譏誚他，說：你不是基督麼？可以救自己和我們罷！

verses.text: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, 'Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same sentence of condemnation?
verses.textZh: 那一個就應聲責備他，說：你既是一樣受刑的，還不怕神麼？

verses.text: 'And we indeed [are suffering] justly, for we are receiving what we deserve for our deeds; but this man has done nothing wrong.'
verses.textZh: 我們是應該的，因我們所受的與我們所做的相稱，但這個人沒有做過一件不好的事。

verses.text: And he was saying, 'Jesus, remember me when You come in Your kingdom!'
verses.textZh: 就說：耶穌阿，你得國降臨的時候，求你記念我！

verses.text: And He said to him, 'Truly I say to you, today you shall be with Me in Paradise.'
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他說：我實在告訴你，今日你要同我在樂園裡了。

verses.text: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness fell over the whole land until the ninth hour,
verses.textZh: 那時約有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，

verses.text: because the sun was obscured; and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
verses.textZh: 日頭變黑了；殿裡的幔子從當中裂為兩半。

verses.text: And Jesus, crying out with a loud voice, said, 'Father, INTO YOUR HANDS I COMMIT MY SPIRIT.' Having said this, He breathed His last.
verses.textZh: 耶穌大聲喊著說：父阿！我將我的靈魂交在你手裡。說了這話，氣就斷了。

verses.text: Now when the centurion saw what had happened, he [began] praising God, saying, 'Certainly this man was innocent.'
verses.textZh: 百夫長看見所成的事，就歸榮耀與神，說：這真是個義人！

verses.text: And all the crowds who came together for this spectacle, when they observed what had happened, [began] to return, beating their breasts.
verses.textZh: 聚集觀看的眾人見了這所成的事都捶著胸回去了。

verses.text: And all His acquaintances and the women who accompanied Him from Galilee were standing at a distance, seeing these things.
verses.textZh: 還有一切與耶穌熟識的人，和從加利利跟著他來的婦女們，都遠遠的站著看這些事。

verses.text: And a man named Joseph, who was a member of the Council, a good and righteous man
verses.textZh: 有一個人名叫約瑟，是個議士，為人善良公義；

verses.text: (he had not consented to their plan and action), [a man] from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God;
verses.textZh: 眾人所謀所為，他並沒有附從。他本是猶太、亞利馬太城裡素常盼望神國的人。

verses.text: this man went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
verses.textZh: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體，

verses.text: And he took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid Him in a tomb cut into the rock, where no one had ever lain.
verses.textZh: 就取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在石頭鑿成的墳墓裡；那裡頭從來沒有葬過人。

verses.text: It was the preparation day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
verses.textZh: 那日是預備日，安息日也快到了。

verses.text: Now the women who had come with Him out of Galilee followed, and saw the tomb and how His body was laid.
verses.textZh: 那些從加利利和耶穌同來的婦女跟在後面，看見了墳墓和他的身體怎樣安放。

verses.text: Then they returned and prepared spices and perfumes. And on the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.
verses.textZh: 他們就回去，預備了香料香膏。他們在安息日，便遵著誡命安息了。
